purpose: Remove the circular May-10 launch assumption, backdate the branch Ichi-Go-equivalent decision/preparation process to where branch motives and geography actually create it, and require a fresh terminal logistics/detection reconstruction before assigning D-day.

supersedes_in_part.ICHIGO_BRANCH_QUALITATIVE_REAUDIT_1944-0: Supersedes launch_window/center and the claim that April acceleration is excluded. Retains Hunan-centric geometry, no large Honan replay, conditional Hengyang, separate Guangxi authorization, and no Sichuan pursuit.
supersedes_in_part.PRE_ICHIGO_FINAL_FORCE_LOGISTICS_GATE_19: Retains OOB/support/Nanjing and structural GO result, but reclassifies early-May stock and May-08_12 timing as target-state estimates rather than proof of an exact launch date.

historical_motives: counter Fourteenth Air Force and south-China activity
restore north-south continental communications as sea transport deteriorated

reason: Guangyuan main area secured late Oct/early Nov 1943
Five-Go has already removed the need to replay the historical full Honan/KOGO phase
Changsha-Hengyang-Guilin/Liuzhou remain high-value Fourteenth Air Force, rail, tax and political nodes
Hanzhong/Guangyuan can pressure Sichuan without a new Chengdu ground offensive

1944-01.reason: B-29/Fourteenth Air Force threat is concrete enough to justify a Hunan-centric operation, while branch geography changes its scope rather than removing its motive.

activities: Fifth Air Army allocation and airfield preparation

1944-04.note: By 1944-04-25 the branch structural gate is GO_STAGED_OPERATION, but the ledger's 175k-225k campaign stock is explicitly described as available 'by early May'. It cannot be used to prove a late-April or May-10 D-day without reconstructing accumulation by date.

operation_geometry.north_china: NO_LARGE_HISTORICAL_HONAN_PHASE; local corridor clearing, rail/bridge repair, security and anti-guerrilla work only

launch_gate_reopened.broad_plausibility_only: late April through first half of May remains plausible, but is not canonical until dated stock/vehicle/bridge/concealment and Chinese detection are reconstructed
required_terminal_inputs: dated Wuhan-Yueyang stock accumulation and immediately drawable stock, at least weekly from 1944-03-15
dated serviceable vehicle count and >=70% continuation threshold
8-11 engineer/bridging battalion-equivalent positioning and bridge-material readiness
railway-repair group positions and line condition
Fifth Air Army normal and 48-72h surge readiness
Fourteenth Air Force/Chinese detection and interdiction reaction
weather/river condition only as an operational modifier, not a calendar fetish
launch_gate_reopened.local_reopen_window: 1944-04-15..1944-04-30 initially; extend earlier if dated concentration records require it
launch_gate_reopened.rule: If the reconstructed terminal gates cross before 1944-04-30, adjudicate the China local combat timeline retroactively before advancing the global clock further.

why_branch_may_launch_earlier_than_histo: No full Honan opening campaign must be completed first.
Nanjing apparatus relieves 3.0-3.8 Japanese division-equivalents of static workload theater-wide.
U-Go is NO-GO, avoiding a major competing Army-air sink.
Branch land/vehicle/aircrew process improvements raise serviceability and preparation efficiency.
why_branch_does_not_launch_as_soon_as_th: 10 divisions still require physical rail, bridge, truck, engineer, ammunition and dispersed-stock preparation.
Five-Go western salient remains an active 2.3-2.8 division-equivalent commitment.
Premium aviation/communications/engineer resources also face Pacific/Marianas demand.
A premature launch increases Fourteenth Air Force interdiction exposure and can strand the advance before Hengyang.
next_action: Reconstruct the terminal China preparation/detection timeline rather than assume a calendar D-day.
